title: Targeting the HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma axis with curcumin carbon dots to combat uranium nephrotoxicity.
authors: Jia, Zhimin; Wang, Chang; Han, Xiaowen; Zeng, Jiawei; He, Chuandong; Chen, Zhengguo; Chen, Yan; Xu, Bei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素碳点靶向HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma轴缓解铀肾毒性，虽含分子对接和ChIP-qPCR验证TF-DNA结合，但核心是毒理学与纳米治疗，非TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: Uranium-induced nephrotoxicity involves complex mechanisms and lacks therapeutic interventions. This study identifies the HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma axis as a key driver of renal lipid reprogramming and injury following uranium exposure. Using molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), ChIP-qPCR, and dual-luciferase reporter assays, we confirmed that HIF-1alpha directly regulates PPARgamma expression and downstream lipotoxicity. The causal role of this axis was further validated using HIF-1alpha knockdown/knockout models and PPARgamma pharmacological modulators (GW9662 and Rosi). Curcumin-derived carbon dots (CCDs) were synthesized at temperatures ranging from 120 to 210  degrees C. As-prepared CCDs-210 exhibited uniform size (< 10 nm), and excellent biocompatibility. Carbonization temperature governed cellular uptake: CCDs-210 entered via active endocytosis, while CCDs-120 used passive diffusion. In uranium-exposed HK-2 cells, CCDs-210 scavenged ROS, stabilized mitochondrial membrane potential, and suppressed the HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma axis, reversing lipid dysregulation and improving cell viability. In vivo, CCDs-210 attenuated renal histopathological damage, restored renal function, and conferred multi-organ protection. These findings establish the HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma axis as a central mediator of uranium nephrotoxicity and demonstrate that CCDs-210, by targeting this axis, effectively mitigate oxidative stress, inflammation, and lipid metabolic disruption. This work provides both a mechanistic foundation and a translatable nanotherapeutic strategy for treating uranium-induced kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 铀诱导的肾毒性涉及复杂机制，且缺乏治疗干预手段。本研究确定HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma轴是铀暴露后肾脏脂质重编程和损伤的关键驱动因素。通过分子对接、免疫共沉淀 (co-immunoprecipitation, Co-IP)、ChIP-qPCR和双荧光素酶报告基因实验，我们证实HIF-1alpha直接调控PPARgamma表达及下游脂毒性。该轴的因果作用进一步通过HIF-1alpha敲低/敲除模型和PPARgamma药理学调节剂（GW9662和Rosi）得到验证。在120至210摄氏度温度范围内合成了姜黄素衍生碳点 (curcumin-derived carbon dots, CCDs)。所制备的CCDs-210表现出均匀尺寸（< 10 nm）和优异的生物相容性。碳化温度决定了细胞摄取方式：CCDs-210通过主动内吞进入细胞，而CCDs-120则利用被动扩散。在铀暴露的HK-2细胞中，CCDs-210清除ROS、稳定线粒体膜电位，并抑制HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma轴，逆转脂质失调并改善细胞活力。在体内，CCDs-210减轻肾脏组织病理损伤、恢复肾功能，并提供多器官保护。这些发现确立了HIF-1alpha/PPARgamma轴作为铀肾毒性的核心介质，并证明CCDs-210通过靶向该轴有效缓解氧化应激、炎症和脂质代谢紊乱。本研究为治疗铀诱导的肾损伤提供了机制基础及可转化的纳米治疗策略。
